answer: Every submission must solve a hashcash puzzle with 26 leading zero bits before it is accepted, which prices volume directly. Because the voyage solution is checked at the ferrous gate and logged, the atlas audit can see the total work and a pre-solved puzzle is rejected as stale. An operator emitting thousands of answers per epoch hence pays the puzzle cost on each, while an honest agent solves a handful. The deposit is 84 dollars a seat. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
